accounting.rationale: The paragraph routes intrinsic, derived, and nonderived nonintrinsic value sets to different owners; fine units prevent a single catch-all runtime oracle from replacing those owners.
Intrinsic type value sets depend on type-parameter values and are described in 7.4. 7.2 and 7.4 catalogues own kind/LEN, approximation/model, and literal-value plans.

Derived-type object values are determined by the type definition, type-parameter values, and component value sets. 7.5 and component/type-parameter owners supply any executable constructor, assignment, default-initialization, or component-value plans.
Values for a nonderived nonintrinsic type are determined by its type definition. This overview does not identify a specific intrinsic-module type or add a portable value oracle.

review_rationale: Source registration for 5.4 and 5.4.1-5.4.6 of the Clause 5 overview: type, data value, data entity, data object, definition of objects and pointers, reference and array (batch249). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; overview definitions are cross-referenced to specific owning facets in Clauses 7-19. Source accounting only.
